actions.action: Perform thermography inspections to identify hot spots and potential thermal faults in the inverter and DC field.
actions.expected_impact: Early detection of thermal anomalies can prevent fire incidents and reduce the associated 25.3% of equipment cost.

actions.action: Conduct IV-curve tracing and insulation resistance tests on the DC cables to detect degradation or short circuits.
actions.expected_impact: Identifying cable issues can prevent recurrence and mitigate the 18.8% cost share of this failure mode.

actions.action: Schedule regular torque checks on connectors to ensure proper tightening and prevent connection issues.
actions.expected_impact: Proper torque maintenance can reduce connector failures and the 8.1% cost share associated with this failure mode.

actions.action: Inspect surge protection devices for proper operation and signs of damage, especially after storm events.
actions.target_failure_mode: Défaillance chaîne et boîtier de jonction
actions.expected_impact: Ensuring surge protection integrity can prevent damage to junction boxes and reduce severe incidents.

actions.action: Implement a cleaning schedule for modules to minimize dirt accumulation and maintain optimal performance.
actions.expected_impact: Regular cleaning can prevent performance degradation and avoid incidents related to dirt buildup.

actions.action: Perform fire-risk inspections focusing on internal faults and material aging in the PV building support structure.
actions.expected_impact: Proactive fire risk management can prevent severe incidents and associated costs.
